root_cause_gates.dominant_component: EvidenceSet structural duplication and fixed per-record schema overhead, especially repeated entity_ref structures; not metadata normalized_value blobs.

OPTION_A_contract_demand_aware_inline_fi.truth_preservation: Safe if claim EvidenceRecords retain entity/key/value/evidence/provenance and generic metadata is not used as claim truth.
OPTION_A_contract_demand_aware_inline_fi.provenance_preservation: Preserves direct claim provenance; generic metadata should be audit-only/ref-backed if retained.
OPTION_A_contract_demand_aware_inline_fi.memory_byte_effect: Useful but insufficient alone. Ratio model without metadata estimates about 33.81 MB full-corpus, still above 8 MB.
OPTION_A_contract_demand_aware_inline_fi.generality: High if based on contract demand rather than media-specific filenames.
OPTION_A_contract_demand_aware_inline_fi.risk: Medium if filter removes audit evidence before a durable raw support ref exists.
OPTION_A_contract_demand_aware_inline_fi.migration_impact: Low if retention policy is stage-local.

OPTION_B_raw_support_object_ref.truth_preservation: Strong if raw support object is immutable, checksum-bound, and referenced from claim records.
OPTION_B_raw_support_object_ref.provenance_preservation: Strong; raw metadata blob can be persisted once and linked by raw_result_id/raw_evidence_ref.
OPTION_B_raw_support_object_ref.memory_byte_effect: Limited for current sample because metadata normalized_value averages only 65 bytes, but valuable for future large raw metadata and audit separation.
OPTION_B_raw_support_object_ref.generality: High for any capability that emits raw support plus claim projections.
OPTION_B_raw_support_object_ref.risk: Requires lifecycle, integrity, resolver and cleanup semantics.
OPTION_B_raw_support_object_ref.testability: High with missing-ref, checksum and replay tests.

OPTION_C_checkpointed_ref_backed_post_co.truth_preservation: Strong if accepted EvidenceRecords remain deterministic and resolvable before validation.
OPTION_C_checkpointed_ref_backed_post_co.provenance_preservation: Strong; avoids forcing all complete ObservationExecutionResults inline.
OPTION_C_checkpointed_ref_backed_post_co.memory_byte_effect: High; directly addresses the all-results-inline accumulation that blocks at 455/2230 groups.
OPTION_C_checkpointed_ref_backed_post_co.risk: Needs atomic commit/ref lifecycle and no late or partial evidence admission.
OPTION_C_checkpointed_ref_backed_post_co.testability: High with replay, missing ref, orphan cleanup and no endpoint hydration tests.

OPTION_D_generic_evidence_set_compaction.truth_preservation: Safe if entity_ref is replaced by stable entity_ref_id plus a single entity_ref table in the same governed payload.
OPTION_D_generic_evidence_set_compaction.provenance_preservation: Safe if claim records still resolve to the exact entity and source refs deterministically.
OPTION_D_generic_evidence_set_compaction.memory_byte_effect: Material. Sample average EvidenceSet overhead minus records is 4,091.82 bytes; entity_refs alone average 3,536.65 bytes per result.
OPTION_D_generic_evidence_set_compaction.risk: Requires compatibility with consumers expecting inline entity_ref on each record.
OPTION_D_generic_evidence_set_compaction.testability: High with semantic equivalence and resolver tests.

OPTION_E_budget_increase_only.truth_preservation: Neutral, but it hides representation inefficiency.
OPTION_E_budget_increase_only.memory_byte_effect: Only moves the limit; observed model suggests about 39 MB current full-corpus inline retention.
OPTION_E_budget_increase_only.generality: Low as a correction because it does not address boundary semantics.
OPTION_E_budget_increase_only.risk: High for future corpora and endpoint hydration.

recommended_architecture.recommended_path: Combine OPTION_C and OPTION_D, with OPTION_A as a contract-aware retention layer and OPTION_B for raw/audit support where raw metadata is large or semantically required.
recommended_architecture.not_recommended: Do not increase the 8 MB budget as the primary fix.
minimal_truthful_retention: Retain claim-relevant EvidenceRecords needed for blocking semantic validation and requested optional artifact fields.
Represent generic metadata as unrequested intermediate/audit evidence unless explicitly demanded by contract.
Deduplicate entity_ref structures within EvidenceSet or replace repeated inline entity_ref with stable entity_ref_id plus a bounded entity_ref table.
Checkpoint or ref-back post-compile result/evidence batches so validation can consume governed evidence without holding every complete ObservationExecutionResult inline.
Expose separate physical telemetry for produced, accepted and policy-rejected evidence.

issues.title: EvidenceSet materialization repeats entity_ref structures materially across records and aggregate entity_refs
supporting_evidence: Sample uses runtime _execution_entity_ref compact projection and current EvidenceSet schema.
Average EvidenceSet entity_refs bytes in sample: 3536.65.
Per-record entity_ref averages about 463-469 bytes across representative keys.
EvidenceSet.entity_refs stores one entity_ref per EvidenceRecord, not unique entity refs.
disconfirming_evidence: No evidence that normalized media values themselves dominate the byte budget.
issues.reason_if_deferred: This is diagnostic-only; production patching forbidden.

issues.title: Full-corpus inline post-compile evidence retention is unlikely to fit the current 8 MB guardrail
issues.architectural_owner: Governed post-compile observation retention / payload boundary
supporting_evidence: B2 observed 7,994,062 bytes after only 455 of 2,230 physical groups.
Observed current representation estimates about 39.18 MB for all 2,230 groups if density remains similar.
Removing unrequested metadata inline alone models about 33.81 MB, still above 8 MB.
disconfirming_evidence: Full-corpus byte model is an estimate, not a public full run.
issues.reason_if_deferred: This is diagnostic-only; production patching forbidden.

issues.title: Generic metadata EvidenceRecords are retained inline despite not being requested by artifact contract
issues.relationship_to_frontier: secondary byte contributor and contract relevance defect
supporting_evidence: The media inventory artifact contract does not request a generic metadata column or claim.
Identity-specific records preserve raw_tag_key, raw_tag_value_repr, raw_result_id, backend_id and semantic_mapper provenance.
disconfirming_evidence: Sample metadata normalized_value averages only 65.06 bytes, so generic metadata is not the dominant byte component in this corpus.
Dropping metadata alone is modeled as insufficient to fit 2,230 groups into 8 MB.
issues.reason_if_deferred: This is diagnostic-only; production patching forbidden.

issues.title: Budget-rejected result loses observer_payload backend telemetry before aggregate backend counts are computed
issues.relationship_to_frontier: telemetry defect at budget rejection boundary
supporting_evidence: B2 physical_probe_count/files_attempted is 455 but attempted_backends.mutagen is 454.
Code computes result_bytes after execution, then replaces over-budget result with _budget_block_result containing empty EvidenceSet and no observer_payload.
_backend_telemetry only counts media summaries from result.provenance.observer_payload.
issues.reason_if_deferred: This is diagnostic-only; production patching forbidden.

issues.title: Public task summary reads artifact/perception materialization state and misses physical execution authority when B2 blocks before downstream artifact materialization
issues.relationship_to_frontier: observability defect; not the first blocking frontier
supporting_evidence: B2 physical authority reports configured=true, available=true, execution_status=partial.
B2 public summary top-level reports media_metadata_capability status=not_configured/configured=false.
UniversalTaskSessionService collects media summaries from artifact declared_contract/perception sources; the B2 physical telemetry remains in result/event metadata after interruption.
issues.reason_if_deferred: This is diagnostic-only; production patching forbidden.

limitations: Byte attribution by key/component is based on a bounded service-equivalent sample from the same corpus, not recovered full B2 raw EvidenceRecords.
Full-corpus capacity models are estimates and are labeled as such.
B2 did not retain the over-budget result evidence payload, so exact rejected result evidence count/bytes are inferred from code path and count deltas, not directly recovered.
